limitations: The Overview summary updates strictly on page entry (`currentRowChanged == 0`) from current in-memory references and does not poll the file system or run an active background monitor[cite: 12].

The CSV interpretation setting is strictly session-scoped and synchronized in memory between the Settings page and the Spectral Data page; persistent cross-session preference files remain intentionally out of scope[cite: 12].
summary: Batch 7 completes the Overview and Settings pages cleanly within the established architectural constraints[cite: 12]. The Overview page provides direct navigation shortcuts across all operational views and presents a plain-text, read-only summary of loaded session state without querying disk storage or triggering network calls[cite: 12]. The Settings page features a bidirectional in-memory synchronization with the Spectral Data CSV schema selector without causing signal loops, and displays read-only paths for project and cache locations without performing disk scans[cite: 12]. Both pages are safely wrapped in QScrollArea widgets while strictly preserving the existing 6-page navigation order[cite: 12]. No actionable defects were identified.
